records.context: The chaining strip: where a module says what it will read, and what is stale.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The chaining strip: where a module says what it will read, and what is stale.
records.translation: La franja de encadenamiento: donde un módulo indica qué va a leer y qué está desactualizado.

records.context: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the laboratory microplate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the microscope field of view;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the plate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the field;
records.translation: **qué va a leer.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` consulta al registro de artefactos dónde escribió realmente el módulo anterior y rellena con ello la carpeta de origen de este módulo, de modo que Measure abierto después de Mask tiene ya rellenada la carpeta de la placa.  Una ruta que el propio usuario escribió queda *fijada* y nunca se sobrescribe: cuando el origen anterior se traslada más tarde, la nueva ubicación se ofrece junto a la fijada con un botón, nunca se impone en el campo;

records.context: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on application view *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on screen *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.translation: **qué está desactualizado.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` convierte los códigos de causa del registro en una frase y una solución, de modo que "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" (estas mediciones proceden de una ejecución de Mask que ha vuelto a hacer desde entonces) aparece en pantalla *antes* de abrir la figura en lugar de descubrirse después;

records.context: **what comes next.**  A finished processing session offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what comes next.**  A finished run offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.translation: **qué viene después.**  Una ejecución terminada ofrece sus sucesores a partir de :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, cada uno rellenado de antemano con el artefacto recién producido y cada uno comprobado con :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready`, de modo que una oferta o bien funciona o bien se muestra atenuada con el motivo por el que no puede funcionar.

records.translation: La instalación pasa por los dos puntos de unión que ya existen en lugar de por la pantalla compartida: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES` (que ``MainWindow._build_screen`` consulta antes de su cadena integrada) y :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`, que importa este módulo después de cargar ``app.py`` y antes de construir la primera ventana.  ``AppScreen`` en sí no se modifica.

records.translation: El pincel es una :class:`~spacr.qt.layer_viewer.CanvasTool`, como el lápiz de ROI y el contador, de modo que toma prestado el ratón del lienzo sin que el lienzo sepa para qué es, y las coordenadas del mundo que recibe son lo que hace que un trazo pintado con zoom de 8× caiga donde cae el mismo trazo a 1×.

records.context: A stroke is dozens of ``move`` events and exactly one thing the user did. :meth:`BrushTool.press` opens a stroke, :meth:`BrushTool.release` closes it, and undo takes back the stroke — not the last few pixels of it. That is the whole reason ``CanvasTool`` grew a ``release`` hook.
records.label: spacr.qt.curation_tool#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A stroke is dozens of ``move`` events and exactly one thing the user did. :meth:`BrushTool.press` opens a stroke, :meth:`BrushTool.release` closes it, and undo takes back the stroke — not the last few pixels of it. That is the whole reason ``CanvasTool`` grew a ``release`` hook.
records.translation: Un trazo son docenas de eventos ``move`` y exactamente una cosa que hizo el usuario. :meth:`BrushTool.press` abre un trazo, :meth:`BrushTool.release` lo cierra, y deshacer revierte el trazo, no sus últimos píxeles. Ese es todo el motivo por el que ``CanvasTool`` incorporó un gancho ``release``.

records.source: Both panels write their ledger after every action rather than on a Save button. A correction that is only in memory when the application is killed is a correction that happened to the data and not to the record of it, and the two disagreeing is worse than neither existing.
records.translation: Ambos paneles escriben su registro de cambios después de cada acción en lugar de con un botón de guardar. Una corrección que solo está en memoria cuando se mata la aplicación es una corrección que afectó a los datos y no a su registro, y que ambos discrepen es peor que no tener ninguno.

records.translation: Históricamente, la aplicación incrustaba el texto en inglés directamente en sus widgets. Sustituir todos los puntos de llamada a la vez haría frágil la localización, por lo que este módulo ofrece dos capas complementarias:

records.context: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` safely updates already-created static Qt labels, buttons, menus, tabs, combo-box choices and accessibility text. Original English strings are retained as dynamic Qt properties, allowing a window to switch from Swedish to Korean (for example) without translating a translation. Editable values and user-entered paths are never touched.
records.label: spacr.qt.i18n#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` safely updates already-created static Qt labels, buttons, menus, tabs, combo-box choices and accessibility text. Original English strings are retained as dynamic Qt properties, allowing a window to switch from Swedish to Korean (for example) without translating a translation. Editable values and user-entered paths are never touched.
records.translation: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` actualiza de forma segura etiquetas, botones, menús, pestañas, opciones de listas desplegables y textos de accesibilidad estáticos de Qt ya creados. Las cadenas originales en inglés se conservan como propiedades dinámicas de Qt, lo que permite que una ventana pase del sueco al coreano (por ejemplo) sin traducir una traducción. Los valores editables y las rutas introducidas por el usuario nunca se tocan.

records.translation: ``only_new`` omite los widgets que esta pasada traduciría exactamente a lo que ya dicen. records.translation: ``only_new`` está desactivado por defecto. El único llamador que lo pide es `_LateCaptionTranslator`, donde tres pasadas cercanas a la raíz, separadas por un turno de eventos, vuelven a recorrer el mismo árbol mientras se ensambla una pantalla de módulo.

records.translation: Una lista desplegable cuyas entradas lee un manejador con ``currentText()`` no se puede traducir: el rótulo cambia y todas las comparaciones fallan. records.context: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that executes in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that runs in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.translation: La función de ROI se divide entre dos módulos. :mod:`spacr.roi` es la mitad que se ejecuta en un hilo de trabajo de medición: la geometría, la regla de conservar o descartar y la vía por entorno que hace llegar ambas a un grupo ``spawn``. Esta es la mitad que necesita un ratón: un lápiz que convierte clics en una :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, y un panel que convierte la capa de formas en un :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` y activa el filtro de medición.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The pen draws into the model, not onto the widget
records.translation: El lápiz dibuja en el modelo, no sobre el widget

records.context: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.translation: Cada vértice es una coordenada del mundo tomada de :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, y el polígono que se dibuja es una :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` real en una :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer` real. Así, la ROI a medio terminar la representa el mismo compositor que todo lo demás, sobrevive a un zoom, y la ROI terminada ya tiene la forma que lee :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer`. Nada del dibujo está en píxeles, y eso es lo que permite que una ROI dibujada sobre una vista previa submuestreada designe la misma región en una máscara a resolución completa.

records.context: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the processing session then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the run then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.translation: Activar el filtro es una sola llamada. El panel muestra si el filtro llegará a los procesos de trabajo que realizan la medición: un filtro registrado solo en el proceso de la GUI no tiene efecto en un hilo de trabajo ``spawn``, y la ejecución mide entonces campos completos sin ninguna advertencia. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` lo informa de antemano, y el panel muestra el resultado con el color de advertencia cuando el filtro no llegará a los procesos de trabajo.

records.context: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.
records.translation: El nivel de revelación solo se cambia cuando es necesario, y el cambio no se recuerda. Pasar siempre a All funcionaría, pero también reescribiría la elección Essentials/All recordada para este módulo cada vez que alguien llegara aquí: un ajuste que eligió el usuario, cambiado como efecto secundario de consultar algo. Por eso primero se borra el filtro y el nivel solo se eleva cuando la fila sigue sin estar en el formulario, que es exactamente el caso en que es Essentials lo que la oculta; y la elevación pasa por :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, de modo que el formulario muestra la fila mientras el almacén sigue guardando el nivel que eligió el usuario. La mayoría de los ajustes no son esenciales, así que una consulta que guardara la elevación sacaría de Essentials para siempre a casi todos los módulos.

records.source: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- the process-wide ``RunRegistry`` that ``make_thread`` adds every job to. Not an ad-hoc "busy" flag each caller has to remember to set and, more importantly, remember to clear: the registry is the same state every screen's ``active_jobs()`` is counting, and it is maintained by ``make_thread`` itself, so a job that forgets to tell anyone it started still turns the spinner on.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry`: el ``RunRegistry`` de todo el proceso al que ``make_thread`` añade cada trabajo. records.context: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on application view -- no duration is estimated.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on screen -- no duration is estimated.
records.translation: Por eso el widget espera :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` segundos (2 por defecto) antes de mostrarse. El mecanismo es un **retardo, no una predicción**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` inicia un temporizador de un solo disparo en el momento en que empieza el trabajo, y el indicador solo se hace visible si :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` *sigue* siendo verdadero cuando se dispara ese temporizador. Un trabajo que termina a los 1.9 s cancela el temporizador al salir y nunca pone nada en pantalla; no se estima ninguna duración.

records.context: The clock executes on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#15
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The clock runs on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.
records.translation: El reloj corre sobre el *trabajo*, no sobre el trabajo individual. Un segundo trabajo que empieza mientras el temporizador está pendiente no lo reinicia: el temporizador solo se arma en la transición de inactivo a ocupado, de modo que dos segundos de actividad continua en segundo plano muestran el indicador aunque ningún trabajo individual haya durado tanto. Pasar a inactivo lo desarma, y la siguiente ráfaga de trabajo inicia dos segundos nuevos.

records.context: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` is the asset this widget was asked to reuse, and it is not reused, for three measured reasons:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#2

records.source: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` is the asset this widget was asked to reuse, and it is not reused, for three measured reasons:
records.translation: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` es el recurso que se pidió reutilizar para este widget, y no se reutiliza, por tres motivos medidos:

records.context: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.translation: **Tamaño.** 800x600, 144 fotogramas, 682 KB en disco. ``QMovie`` decodifica cada fotograma en una ``QImage`` de 32 bits, de modo que un fotograma ocupa 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB y todo el bucle 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` lo retiene todo; ``CacheNone`` (el predeterminado) lo cambia por volver a decodificar 1.92 MB, y reescalarlo a 16 px, 33 veces por segundo, indefinidamente.

records.context: **Transparency.** Every pixel of every frame has alpha 255 and the background is ``#000000``. The GIF is not a sprite, it is a *video of* a spinner. Dropped beside "Clear console" it paints an opaque black square, which is invisible in the dark theme and a hole in the light one.

records.context: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#6

records.source: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.translation: Preescalar los fotogramas una vez en objetos ``QPixmap`` resuelve el coste por fotograma pero ninguno de los otros dos problemas, y sigue costando una pasada de decodificación de 276 MB en el arranque para un punto de 16 px. Por eso el motivo se vuelve a dibujar: el *carácter* del GIF es un anillo fino con una trenza de doble hélice que lo recorre (véanse los fotogramas: la trenza se desplaza y el anillo permanece), y eso es exactamente lo que dibuja :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` con dos objetos ``QPolygonF``. Cuesta microsegundos, toma sus colores de la paleta activa, por lo que se adapta tanto al tema claro como al oscuro, y es nítido a cualquier tamaño.

This layout owns no widths. It asks the paired table's ``QHeaderView`` where each section starts and how wide it is, every time it lays out, and it writes nothing back: the header never learns that a strip is following it, so there is nothing to drift.
records.translation: Hay un solo modelo de columnas, leído en un único sentido. Una segunda tabla encima de la primera, con instrucciones de mantener las mismas anchuras, serían dos modelos de columnas mantenidos en sincronía (véase la docstring de `_ClusterSettingsDialog` sobre dos editores de un mismo ajuste). Esta disposición no posee ninguna anchura. Pregunta al ``QHeaderView`` de la tabla emparejada dónde empieza cada sección y qué anchura tiene, cada vez que se dispone, y no escribe nada de vuelta: la cabecera nunca sabe que una franja la sigue, así que no hay nada que pueda desincronizarse.

records.context: A QLayout is used rather than spacers in a QHBoxLayout. Stretches and fixed spacers can be tuned to line up at one column width and are wrong at every other one, so each drag of a column edge would mean rebuilding them. A layout's ``setGeometry`` runs on every relayout anyway, so reading the header there is both shorter and correct at any width; all that is left to arrange is that a column resize causes a relayout, which is what the ``sectionResized`` connection below is for.

records.source: A QLayout is used rather than spacers in a QHBoxLayout. Stretches and fixed spacers can be tuned to line up at one column width and are wrong at every other one, so each drag of a column edge would mean rebuilding them. A layout's ``setGeometry`` runs on every relayout anyway, so reading the header there is both shorter and correct at any width; all that is left to arrange is that a column resize causes a relayout, which is what the ``sectionResized`` connection below is for.
records.translation: Se usa un QLayout en lugar de espaciadores en un QHBoxLayout. Los estiramientos y los espaciadores fijos se pueden ajustar para alinearse con una anchura de columna y son incorrectos con cualquier otra, de modo que cada arrastre del borde de una columna obligaría a reconstruirlos. El ``setGeometry`` de una disposición se ejecuta de todos modos en cada redistribución, así que leer la cabecera ahí es más breve y correcto con cualquier anchura; solo queda conseguir que un cambio de tamaño de columna provoque una redistribución, que es para lo que sirve la conexión ``sectionResized`` de abajo.

records.source: The reads leave the GUI thread deliberately: the summary stats every database and then opens each with sqlite, over paths that are the user's own -- one of them an autofs mount that had not answered a single stat after twenty seconds -- and doing that while a settings panel lays out froze the application. Two runners rather than one, because ``job_finished`` carries a bool and no job identity: a shared runner could not tell whose failure it was being told about, so the restore check failing would clear the summary read's in-flight flag and paint its error over a read still running.
records.translation: Las lecturas salen del hilo de la GUI deliberadamente: el resumen consulta con stat cada base de datos y después abre cada una con sqlite, sobre rutas que son del propio usuario (una de ellas un montaje autofs que no había respondido a un solo stat tras veinte segundos), y hacerlo mientras se disponía un panel de ajustes congelaba la aplicación. Dos ejecutores en lugar de uno, porque ``job_finished`` transmite un bool y ninguna identidad de trabajo: un ejecutor compartido no podría saber de quién es el fallo que se le comunica, de modo que un fallo de la comprobación de restauración borraría el indicador de lectura en curso del resumen y pintaría su error sobre una lectura que sigue en ejecución.

records.context: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.translation: Tres cosas marcan la diferencia entre una revelación que parece deliberada y una que se dispara mientras se apunta a otra cosa:

records.context: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.translation: **Permanencia, no contacto.** Entrar en la franja inicia :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; un puntero que cruza la franja de camino a otro lugar ya ha salido antes de que se dispare el temporizador.

records.context: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.translation: **Un cierre generoso.** Salir *no* cierra de inmediato: :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` cubre el hueco entre el panel y donde se haya desviado el puntero, y cualquier nueva entrada lo cancela. Los paneles que se cierran de golpe en cuanto el puntero se desvía son inutilizables con un panel táctil.

records.context: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.translation: **Una fijación.** De lo contrario, hacer clic en cualquier fila mientras el cajón está abierto competiría con la animación de cierre. :meth:`hold` lo mantiene abierto hasta que algo lo libera explícitamente, que es también como funciona la vía de teclado.

records.context: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. The window installs a shortcut for this — a reveal you can only reach by hovering is a reveal a keyboard user cannot reach at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.translation: **No es solo para el ratón.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` abre el cajón, lo fija y pone el foco en la primera fila; Escape (o que el foco salga del panel) lo vuelve a cerrar. La ventana instala un atajo para ello: una revelación a la que solo se llega pasando el puntero es una revelación a la que un usuario de teclado no puede llegar en absoluto.

records.context: The context-menu route is deliberately an application-level event filter rather than an edit to each table application view. records.translation: La vía del menú contextual es deliberadamente un filtro de eventos a nivel de aplicación y no una modificación de cada pantalla de tabla. records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_dictionary.FeatureHelpFilter.eventFilter#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: Primero se lee el tipo de evento y después vienen las comprobaciones de que el objeto sigue vivo. Este filtro está en la QApplication, así que antes ambas llamadas a `_still_alive` se ejecutaban para cada evento del proceso: 94,431 durante una apertura de Regression, y un perfil contó el par en 839,906 llamadas en una apertura de Mask. Leer el tipo de un objeto cuya mitad C++ ha desaparecido lanza una excepción, a la que el `except` de abajo ya responde con el mismo `False`, así que el orden no cuesta nada y las comprobaciones ahora solo se ejecutan para un menú contextual.

records.context: The console provides the interaction model. A heading that is not already at the top of the viewport is a request to go there, whatever its state -- a first click that hid the very section the user was reaching for spends the gesture on the opposite of what it looked like. Only a heading already at the top has nowhere left to navigate to, and there folding is the one thing the gesture can still mean, on a second click exactly where the user's hand already is.

Only a heading already at the top has nowhere left to navigate to, and there folding is the one thing the gesture can still mean, on a second click exactly where the user's hand already is.
records.translation: La consola aporta el modelo de interacción. Un encabezado que no está ya en la parte superior de la vista es una petición de IR ALLÍ, sea cual sea su estado: un primer clic que ocultara precisamente la sección que buscaba el usuario gastaría el gesto en lo contrario de lo que parecía. Solo un encabezado que ya está arriba no tiene adónde navegar, y ahí plegar es lo único que el gesto puede seguir significando, con un segundo clic justo donde ya está la mano del usuario.

records.translation: La etapa se lee del registro de aplicaciones al construir el botón, y el registro deja de responder por un módulo el día en que se elimina su fila, que es en lo que acaba plegar uno. Restablecerla tiene que mover LAS DOS cosas que decide la etapa: la propiedad de Qt sobre la que selecciona la regla de paso del puntero incluida, y el relleno ``:checked`` local del widget, que es una hoja de estilos calculada una sola vez a partir de la etapa que hubiera durante la construcción. records.source: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a worker thread, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the threading rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a GUI-thread object, never a closure, so the handler runs on the GUI thread and the QThread is retired. Given the screen's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a dictionary lookup.
records.translation: Por eso :func:`warm_annotation` hace todo eso en un hilo de trabajo, mediante :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, que es el módulo que ya aplica correctamente las reglas de hilos: el ``finished`` del hilo de trabajo se retransmite a través de una Signal cuyo receptor es un método vinculado de un objeto del hilo de la GUI, nunca un cierre, de modo que el manejador se ejecuta en el hilo de la GUI y el QThread se retira. Con los términos propios de la pantalla, precalienta todos los genes en una sola unión (400 genes cuestan los mismos 21 ms que uno), tras lo cual un clic es una consulta de diccionario.

The thread's lifetime is guarded twice, because Qt aborts the process if a running ``QThread`` is destroyed and a panel can be dropped without ever being closed -- a tab rebuilt, a screen replaced, an interpreter shutting down.
records.translation: La búsqueda de anotaciones se precalienta en un hilo de trabajo, y solo cuando el panel se ha mostrado realmente: de lo contrario, un panel restablecido con la misma tabla en cada movimiento de filtro iniciaría un hilo por cada redibujado sin ningún gen nuevo. La vida del hilo está protegida por partida doble, porque Qt aborta el proceso si se destruye un ``QThread`` en ejecución y un panel se puede descartar sin haberse cerrado nunca: una pestaña reconstruida, una pantalla sustituida, un intérprete que se apaga.

A panel built, handed a table and dropped -- a tab rebuilt, a screen replaced, a headless script, a test -- reaches neither, and Qt calls `abort()` on the running thread. That was SIGABRT on `QApplication([]); RegressionResultsPanel()`.
records.translation: Las otras dos protecciones necesitan cada una que se dispare un evento. `closeEvent` necesita que alguien cierre el panel; `QApplication.aboutToQuit` necesita un bucle de eventos que termine. Un panel construido, al que se entrega una tabla y que se descarta (una pestaña reconstruida, una pantalla sustituida, un script sin interfaz gráfica, una prueba) no llega a ninguno de los dos, y Qt llama a `abort()` sobre el hilo en ejecución. Eso era un SIGABRT en `QApplication([]); RegressionResultsPanel()`.

records.context: Everything here is swallowed on purpose. `__del__` runs during garbage collection and at interpreter shutdown, where the C++ half may already be gone and the module globals may already be None; an exception thrown here is printed and ignored by Python anyway, and the one thing worth doing is the shutdown attempt.

records.source: Everything here is swallowed on purpose. `__del__` runs during garbage collection and at interpreter shutdown, where the C++ half may already be gone and the module globals may already be None; an exception raised here is printed and ignored by Python anyway, and the one thing worth doing is the shutdown attempt.
records.translation: Todo aquí se descarta a propósito. `__del__` se ejecuta durante la recolección de basura y al apagar el intérprete, cuando la mitad C++ puede haber desaparecido ya y las variables globales del módulo pueden ser ya None; una excepción lanzada aquí Python la imprime y la ignora de todos modos, y lo único que vale la pena hacer es el intento de detención.

records.context: That reveal is per setting. records.context: Only one tooltip ever appears. The application views that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for application view readers.

Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for screen readers.
records.translation: Solo aparece una información emergente. Por eso, reclamar un ancla le instala :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor`, que se traga ``QEvent.ToolTip`` y deja intacto ``toolTip()`` para los lectores de pantalla.

records.context: The walk over dropped paths executes on its own worker. A drop is a path the user chose, and a laboratory microplate lives on the microscope's share: one ``os.path.exists`` under a sleeping autofs mount had not returned after twenty seconds, and a walk is thousands of those. Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a processing session, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.

records.source: The walk over dropped paths runs on its own worker. A drop is a path the user chose, and a plate lives on the microscope's share: one ``os.path.exists`` under a sleeping autofs mount had not returned after twenty seconds, and a walk is thousands of those. Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a run, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.
records.translation: El recorrido sobre las rutas soltadas se ejecuta en su propio hilo de trabajo. Lo soltado es una ruta que eligió el usuario, y una placa está en el recurso compartido del microscopio: un solo ``os.path.exists`` bajo un montaje autofs en reposo no había respondido tras veinte segundos, y un recorrido son miles de ellos. Ejecutado en línea, el recorrido congelaría la aplicación sin traza de error, porque un bucle de eventos detenido no es un fallo. El ejecutor se marca como no visible para el usuario porque soltar una carpeta no es iniciar una ejecución, y es seguro hacerlo porque ese ejecutor no lleva nada más que el recorrido.

records.context: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the microplate sample positions that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the wells that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", the derived wells are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.translation: El panel se abre con los mejores resultados seleccionados: las guías o los genes significativos principales y los pocillos que los contienen, que el usuario puede cambiar. La tabla de resultados de la regresión proporciona los resultados (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); sin ella, la selección son las guías de los propios grupos del montaje. El cuadro de población empieza entonces en "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells" (guías y otros puntos de datos de los pocillos seleccionados), los pocillos derivados se muestran bajo los controles, y "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" cambian cualquiera de los dos. Si no hay nada que seleccionar, empieza en "All datapoints" (todos los puntos de datos), de modo que un panel sin guías sigue dibujando lo que dibujaba antes.

records.source: This widget is therefore plain. Nothing wraps, nothing is elided, and the character in column forty of one read sits directly above the character in column forty of the next, which is the reason to look at reads rather than at a table.
records.translation: Por eso este widget es sencillo. Dibuja el texto de las lecturas en una fuente de ancho fijo, una lectura por línea, y pinta los caracteres con los que coincidió un código de barras en un color propio de ese tipo de código de barras. Nada se ajusta ni se abrevia, y el carácter de la columna cuarenta de una lectura queda justo encima del carácter de la columna cuarenta de la siguiente, que es el motivo para mirar las lecturas y no una tabla.

records.context: Colour: every colour painted here is derived from the theme that is on application view, never written as a literal, and the derivation preserves the relative luminance of the theme's own accent role. Contrast is a function of relative luminance and of nothing else, so a colour made this way clears exactly the contrast that the accent already clears on that theme, including the themes whose panels are translucent over a photograph. That is what lets an arbitrary number of barcode types each get a colour of their own without any of them becoming unreadable on any theme.

That is what lets an arbitrary number of barcode types each get a colour of their own without any of them becoming unreadable on any theme.
records.translation: Color: cada color que se pinta aquí se deriva del tema que está en pantalla, nunca se escribe como literal, y la derivación conserva la luminancia relativa del rol de acento propio del tema. El contraste es función de la luminancia relativa y de nada más, de modo que un color creado así alcanza exactamente el contraste que ya alcanza el acento en ese tema, incluidos los temas cuyos paneles son translúcidos sobre una fotografía. Eso es lo que permite que un número arbitrario de tipos de códigos de barras reciba cada uno su propio color sin que ninguno se vuelva ilegible en ningún tema.

records.context: What it guarantees. Reads are drawn in a fixed pitch face at fixed character positions, so column forty of one read sits above column forty of the next. A read never wraps onto a second visual row: a long one makes the view scroll sideways instead, because a wrapped read would break the one-read-per-row layout. A barcode type keeps one colour for as long as the view is showing it, so the eye can follow a match down the rows, and a legend above the reads says which colour is which.

records.source: What it guarantees. Reads are drawn in a fixed pitch face at fixed character positions, so column forty of one read sits above column forty of the next. A read never wraps onto a second visual row: a long one makes the view scroll sideways instead, because a wrapped read would break the one-read-per-row layout. A barcode type keeps one colour for as long as the view is showing it, so the eye can follow a match down the rows, and a legend above the reads says which colour is which.
records.translation: Qué garantiza. Las lecturas se dibujan en una fuente de ancho fijo en posiciones de carácter fijas, de modo que la columna cuarenta de una lectura queda encima de la columna cuarenta de la siguiente. Una lectura nunca se ajusta en una segunda fila visual: una larga hace que la vista se desplace en horizontal, porque una lectura ajustada rompería la disposición de una lectura por fila. Un tipo de código de barras conserva un mismo color mientras la vista lo muestre, para que la vista pueda seguir una coincidencia a lo largo de las filas, y una leyenda encima de las lecturas indica qué color es cada uno.

records.source: How overlaps are settled. The spans of a read are read in the order they were given. The first span to cover a character keeps that character.
records.translation: Cómo se resuelven los solapamientos. Los tramos de una lectura se leen en el orden en que se proporcionaron. El primer tramo que cubre un carácter se queda con ese carácter.

records.context: A later span still colours every character that is still free, so it is trimmed rather than hidden. The rule is applied before anything is drawn, which turns an overlap into a question of priority instead of a broken picture. To let one barcode type win an overlap, list its spans first.

records.source: A later span still colours every character that is still free, so it is trimmed rather than hidden. records.translation: Un tramo posterior sigue coloreando todos los caracteres que estén libres, de modo que se recorta en lugar de ocultarse. La regla se aplica antes de dibujar nada, lo que convierte un solapamiento en una cuestión de prioridad en lugar de una imagen rota. Para que un tipo de código de barras gane un solapamiento, ponga sus tramos primero.

records.context: What it costs. The reads are held in a list model and drawn by a delegate, so handing over reads costs a list assignment and drawing costs only the rows that are actually on application view. Setting ten thousand reads and showing the view resolves the character ownership of a screenful of rows, not of ten thousand, which is what keeps the interface responsive on a real FASTQ sample rather than on a toy one.

records.source: What it costs. The reads are held in a list model and drawn by a delegate, so handing over reads costs a list assignment and drawing costs only the rows that are actually on screen. Setting ten thousand reads and showing the view resolves the character ownership of a screenful of rows, not of ten thousand, which is what keeps the interface responsive on a real FASTQ sample rather than on a toy one.
records.translation: Qué cuesta. Las lecturas se guardan en un modelo de lista y las dibuja un delegado, de modo que entregar lecturas cuesta una asignación de lista y dibujar solo cuesta las filas que están realmente en pantalla. Establecer diez mil lecturas y mostrar la vista resuelve la propiedad de los caracteres de una pantalla de filas, no de diez mil, que es lo que mantiene la interfaz ágil con una muestra FASTQ real y no con una de juguete.

records.source: THE SAME FRACTION ON EVERY CARD, so a settings popup and the first-run window wear one rim rather than two takes on it. records.translation: LA MISMA FRACCIÓN EN TODAS LAS TARJETAS, de modo que una ventana emergente de ajustes y la ventana del primer arranque llevan un mismo borde y no dos versiones distintas. La preferencia del arco es una longitud en píxeles y se interpreta como la longitud que debe aparentar en la superficie de REFERENCIA; medida en cambio sobre el perímetro propio de cada tarjeta, los mismos 280 px cubren una sexta parte de la ventana de configuración y dos quintas partes de una ventana emergente pequeña, y en la corta se ve como una banda gruesa y brillante: "the rim is to thick and bright. make the rim and window look exactly like the setup spacr window."

records.source: UNDER ``spaceout`` THE RIM OSCILLATES IN EVERY MODE. The mark that follows the pointer is the one thing on a card that is already moving, and leaving it a fixed blue under a theme whose whole point is a moving spectrum is what the request is about. Its hue is the palette's own drift plus a much faster cycle of its own (:data:`SPACEOUT_RIM_PERIOD`), so it belongs to the same spectrum the rest of the window is travelling through instead of being a second unrelated rainbow.
records.translation: CON ``spaceout`` EL BORDE OSCILA EN TODOS LOS MODOS. records.context: The ray from the centre, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.setup_card.SetupCard.perimeter_position#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: THE RAY FROM THE CENTRE, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.
records.translation: EL RAYO DESDE EL CENTRO, no el borde más cercano. Proyectar un punto sobre el borde que resulte más cercano es discontinuo a lo largo de las diagonales: el puntero cruza una y el objetivo salta del centro del borde superior al centro del izquierdo, que es lo que se notificó como un borde desincronizado con el puntero dentro de la tarjeta. El punto donde el rayo que va del centro al puntero sale del rectángulo se mueve de forma continua y es siempre el lugar del borde que está realmente en la dirección del puntero, que es lo que tiene que significar "flows towards the mouse" (fluye hacia el ratón) si el ratón puede estar en cualquier sitio.

records.context: So this shows the frames. One field plays as a movie; clicking it opens a filmstrip above, which is the same frames laid out at once and scrollable, because a break is easiest to find by scrubbing and easiest to *understand* by seeing the frames either side of it together.

records.source: So this shows the frames. One field plays as a movie; clicking it opens a filmstrip above, which is the same frames laid out at once and scrollable, because a break is easiest to find by scrubbing and easiest to *understand* by seeing the frames either side of it together.
records.translation: Por eso esto muestra los fotogramas. Un campo se reproduce como película; hacer clic en él abre encima una tira de fotogramas, que son los mismos fotogramas dispuestos a la vez y desplazables, porque una rotura se encuentra más fácilmente recorriendo la secuencia y se *entiende* más fácilmente viendo juntos los fotogramas de ambos lados.

records.context: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_movie#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.
records.translation: Todo reutiliza la representación que ya existe en :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview`: ``render_frame`` colorea los contornos de las máscaras por identificador de trayectoria y dibuja la polilínea de estela, y ``track_colour`` es determinista, de modo que un color identifica una trayectoria: un objeto que conserva su identificador de trayectoria conserva su color en todos los fotogramas y en todas las miniaturas, así que un intercambio de identidad se ve como un objeto que cambia de color a mitad de la tira.

records.context: Three design rules:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three design rules:
records.translation: Tres reglas de diseño:

records.context: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless workflow calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on application view, at full vector quality.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless pipeline calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on screen, at full vector quality.
records.translation: **Un solo renderizador.** Cada píxel procede de :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, la misma función a la que llama la canalización sin interfaz gráfica. La exportación vuelve a representar a partir del mismo :class:`VolcanoStyle` a tamaño de impresión en lugar de hacer una captura del widget, de modo que lo que se guarda es lo que había en pantalla, con calidad vectorial completa.

records.context: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.translation: **El estilo es un valor.** Los controles escriben en un :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` y piden un redibujado. Eso hace que toda la apariencia se pueda guardar en JSON, volver a cargar y reproducir.

records.context: **Clicking is a lookup, not a hit test on pixels.** The nearest point is found in data space normalised by the axis ranges, so a click is as accurate on a squashed axis as on a square one.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Clicking is a lookup, not a hit test on pixels.** The nearest point is found in data space normalised by the axis ranges, so a click is as accurate on a squashed axis as on a square one.
records.translation: **Hacer clic es una consulta, no una prueba de impacto sobre píxeles.** El punto más cercano se busca en el espacio de datos normalizado por los rangos de los ejes, de modo que un clic es igual de preciso en un eje comprimido que en uno cuadrado.
